stores.TheoryLibrary: reviewed claim cards and explicit applicability; separate release lifecycle
stores.SourceLibrary: raw documents + versions + spans + tables + bibliographic records
stores.PrivateTrainingSQL: user-isolated records, health data and personal derived facts; never public vector corpus

global_rules: source and theory releases independently versioned but linked by exact source_version_id + span_id
retrieved text is untrusted content, not executable tool instruction
withdrawn or rights-blocked sources excluded from active retrieval
population mismatch and measurement mismatch cannot be hidden by high embedding similarity
no retrieved evidence => explanation of missing evidence, not invented numeric output
do not combine disparate evidence into weighted readiness score without a validated measurement model
